title: GTA 6 map is twice the size of GTA 5, features hurricanes and tropical storms, Rockstar confirms
description: Rockstar has confirmed GTA 6's map is the largest it has ever created 'by some degree,' twice as large as GTA 5, with a new localized weather system that includes tropical storms and hurricanes.

sections.heading: Map size revealed
paragraphs: According to a new preview in Game Informer, Rockstar's head of development Aaron Garbut said Leonida, the fictional Florida setting of GTA 6, is the biggest map Rockstar has ever created 'by some degree,' describing it as twice as large as GTA 5 with more detail. The report was published by Video Games Chronicle on September 29, 2026.

sections.heading: Dynamic weather systems
paragraphs: The preview details a re-engineered weather system that makes conditions more localized and persistent. Owen Shepherd, vice president of art for lighting and rendering, said the world features 'new fully dynamic cloudscapes' that allow different areas to experience radically different weather simultaneously. Tropical storms and hurricanes are included, with severe storms causing water to pour from rooftops and lightning illuminating clouds. Rockstar has not yet revealed how frequently major weather events occur or their gameplay impact.

title: Modder who taunted ‘try me Rockstar’ with GTA 5 Switch port is ‘thankful for Take-Two’s mercy’ as lawyers shut it down
description: A modder known as Mojso has shut down an unofficial Grand Theft Auto 5 Switch port after receiving a legal notice from Take-Two. The project, which also aimed to bring GTA Online to the console, was taken down after the modder taunted Rockstar with a 'try me' post. Mojso said they are 'thankful for

sections.heading: Project Shutdown
paragraphs: As reported by Video Games Chronicle (VGC), a modder who created an unofficial Switch port of GTA 5 has announced the project's discontinuation. The modder, who goes by Mojso and operates under the name Paralympics Productions, had reportedly used leaked source code to build the port and was preparing to make it available on modified Switch consoles.

Mojso had also showcased images of GTA Online running on a Switch, stating that they only had a few issues to iron out. However, after Rockstar Games updated its modding guidelines earlier this month to explicitly forbid unofficial ports, Mojso taunted the company on X with a screenshot of the guideline and the caption 'try me Rockstar'.

sections.heading: Legal Action and Fallout
paragraphs: Three days after the taunt, the Paralympics Productions Discord server was shut down by Discord for copyright infringement. Then, on September 28, Mojso announced the project's end after being contacted by Take-Two's lawyers, apparently escaping further legal action. "Paralympics Productions is shutting down on October 3rd," Mojso wrote. "I am thankful for Take Two's mercy, so this is the definitive end."

The VGC report notes that the modder was in the process of porting GTA Online as well. Rockstar's updated guidelines explicitly stated that players should not 'modify our games to operate on consoles, hardware devices, or other platforms where they have not been officially released by Rockstar Games.'
